description: Bookmarks' settings page, the settings round trip in a sandbox, run by bookmarks-settings-probe.mjs (which starts from the sandbox's settings and puts them back in a finally). The tabs Settings | Data | Diagnostics under the banners, Settings shown; every setting on the page shows the server's value; the Clip folder help keeps clips out of libraries (a Home Videos library of their own, never a Movies or TV library); every field set on the page to a value that isn't its default (the shortcut typed, its check under the field) and saved with the Save button: the server has exactly those values, the developer settings untouched; after a reload the page shows them again, with no Jellyfin Enhanced banner (its setting off); the shortcut field checks as it is typed (M taken by the video player, Shift+ not a combination, refused by Save without a change); the settings put back.

the web client is ready
the settings before

steps.eval: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigPage:not(.hide)'); const tabs = Array.from(p.querySelectorAll('#BookmarksTabs [role=tab]')); return { list: p.querySelector('#BookmarksTabs').getAttribute('role'), names: tabs.map(t => t.textContent.trim()), selected: tabs.map(t => t.getAttribute('aria-selected')), panels: ['BookmarksConfigForm', 'BookmarksData', 'BookmarksDiagnostics'].map(id => !p.querySelector('#' + id).classList.contains('hide')), bannersFirst: p.querySelector('#BookmarksBanners').nextElementSibling.id }; })()

steps.name: the Clip folder help: the default folder, else a Home Videos library of its own; never a Movies or TV library
the help says so, and nothing suggests a library folder without the warnings
steps.assert: /outside every library: the right choice unless clips should be browsable in Jellyfin/.test(__vars.help) && /a library of type Home Videos and Photos for exactly that folder/.test(__vars.help) && /Never use a Movies or TV library, or a folder inside any library/.test(__vars.help) && !/Point it at a folder inside a library/.test(__vars.help)

steps.name: set every field but the shortcut to a value that isn't its default
steps.script: const p = document.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigPage:not(.hide)'); const want = {"EnableWebUi": false, "ReportWebAnchorProblems": false, "EnableBookmarksPage": false, "EnableClipsPage": false, "PageHostMode": "Auto", "RegisterPluginPages": false, "ShowFallbackNav": false, "ShowPlayerButtons": false, "BookmarkNowShortcut": "Ctrl+Alt+K", "AskForNameDefault": true, "SuggestChapterNames": false, "ShowJellyfinEnhancedBanner": false, "DeletedUserPolicy": "Delete", "DetachedRetentionDays": 120, "SnapshotsToKeep": 14, "EnableClips": false, "AdminsCanManageAllClips": false, "ClipOutputPath": __vars.clipFolder, "MinFreeSpaceMegabytes": 4096, "OrganizeClipsByUser": false, "DefaultClipMode": "Fast", "MaxClipDurationSeconds": 900, "MaxConcurrentClips": 2, "MissingClipRetentionDays": 45, "CleanUpPartialFilesOnStartup": false, "VideoPreset": "slow", "VideoCrf": 18, "MaxVideoHeight": 1080, "AudioBitrateKbps": 256, "AudioChannels": 6}; Object.keys(want).filter(n => n !== 'BookmarkNowShortcut').forEach(n => { const e = p.querySelector('#' + n); if (e.type === 'checkbox') { e.checked = want[n]; } else { e.value = String(want[n]); } e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); }); return true;

steps.name: type the shortcut
its check under the field: free, saved as Ctrl+Alt+K
steps.waitFor: document.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigPage:not(.hide)').querySelector('#BookmarksShortcutCheck').textContent === 'Ctrl+Alt+K is free: neither the video player nor Jellyfin Enhanced takes it. Saving writes it as Ctrl+Alt+K.'

saved

steps.assert: (() => { const want = {"EnableWebUi": false, "ReportWebAnchorProblems": false, "EnableBookmarksPage": false, "EnableClipsPage": false, "PageHostMode": "Auto", "RegisterPluginPages": false, "ShowFallbackNav": false, "ShowPlayerButtons": false, "BookmarkNowShortcut": "Ctrl+Alt+K", "AskForNameDefault": true, "SuggestChapterNames": false, "ShowJellyfinEnhancedBanner": false, "DeletedUserPolicy": "Delete", "DetachedRetentionDays": 120, "SnapshotsToKeep": 14, "EnableClips": false, "AdminsCanManageAllClips": false, "ClipOutputPath": __vars.clipFolder, "MinFreeSpaceMegabytes": 4096, "OrganizeClipsByUser": false, "DefaultClipMode": "Fast", "MaxClipDurationSeconds": 900, "MaxConcurrentClips": 2, "MissingClipRetentionDays": 45, "CleanUpPartialFilesOnStartup": false, "VideoPreset": "slow", "VideoCrf": 18, "MaxVideoHeight": 1080, "AudioBitrateKbps": 256, "AudioChannels": 6}; return Object.keys(want).every(n => __vars.saved[n] === want[n]) && ["EnablePageDemo", "EnableDemoPageB", "EnableIdentityDemo", "EnableUserDataDemo", "EnableLibraryChangeDemo", "EnableLibraryDemo", "DeveloperClockOffsetDays"].every(n => __vars.saved[n] === __vars.original[n]); })()

Choose another key." && w.getAttribute('data-valid') === 'true' && w.children.length === 0)(document.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigPage:not(.hide)').querySelector('#BookmarksShortcutCheck .bookmarksShortcutWarning'))
